entries.desc: A material code diff story with one valid current-material local review round satisfies the review assurance floor without requiring 3x2 by default
A docs-only markdown diff is not classified as material code and is not overblocked by the zero-review code floor
A material code diff story with zero current-material review evidence is blocked before DONE with an actionable review assurance floor message
A validation failure, bug, or verified finding signal makes a material code story require three local single-host rounds before DONE
A failure-triggered story remains escalated after repair until the required fresh-material rounds exist
Stale or missing materialDigest host verdicts do not satisfy the failure-triggered 3x1 requirement
Local review assurance reports authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, and productionDone=false for both one-round and 3x1 evidence
Degraded single-host evidence is labeled degraded-single-host and never as two-host independent review
A forged local process event that claims Authority completion does not become Authority Server receipt-backed proof
The smoke task covers zero-review block, one-round pass, failure-triggered 3x1 pass, and Authority flags false
DONE preflight diagnostics name the missing assurance reason and next action
Process-fact contract fails if the new DONE gate semantics are documented only in prose and not registered as gate-consumed facts
